about_text: I am a passionate and creative individual who enjoys exploring different forms of expression through esports, photography, video editing, and event management. I enjoy connecting with people, capturing moments, managing events, and contributing to communities that bring energy and excitement to college life.

experience.title: Founder, IIIT Nagpur Esports Club
experience.description: Helped build and manage the gaming community within the institute. Organized esports tournaments, managed gaming events, coordinated teams, and handled registrations.

experience.title: Co-Lead – Hospitality, Abhivyakti 2026
experience.description: Co-Lead of the Hospitality Team for Abhivyakti 2026, the flagship cultural festival of IIIT Nagpur. Managed guest coordination, accommodation, volunteers, and on-ground operations.

experience.title: Creative Explorer
experience.description: Exploring creative side quests outside academics through content creation, media work, event involvement, and collaborative activities.

projects.title: Visual Storytelling & Photography
projects.description: Capturing candid moments, events, emotions, and aesthetic visuals. Experimenting with angles, lighting, and compositions to tell stories through images.

projects.title: Cinematic Video Editing
projects.description: Creating engaging visual content by combining clips, music, transitions, and effects. Specializing in event highlight videos, esports content, and reels.
